outputs.justify_why_test_is_missing: Panel A shows microscopy time-lapse images which are qualitative visual data, not quantitative measurements requiring statistical comparison

Panel B shows quantitative graphs comparing normalized intensities between euchromatin and heterochromatin conditions. The caption mentions that the data shows different responses between conditions and that a diffusion model fails to reproduce heterochromatin curves, indicating significant differences. Statistical tests should be provided to validate these apparent differences between the two chromatin types.
